description: Defines functions and structures related to marking objects as reachable in a version control system, likely part of Git's internal codebase.

methods.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
methods.description: Adds recent objects that have not been seen yet to the traversal process, using a callback to report objects.

methods.name: mark_reachable_objects
methods.description: Marks objects as reachable within the traversal based on provided parameters.

ctags.name: report_recent_object_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void report_recent_object_fn(const struct object *, struct packed_git *,$/
